settings.heading: Stories of Transformation from the SaunaSpace® Community

settings.content: How People Are Using Infrared Sauna Therapy to Feel Better Every Day

Wondering what kind of results people actually get with SaunaSpace? You’re not alone. One of the most common questions we hear is: Does near-infrared sauna therapy really work? These stories from our community help answer that.

People use SaunaSpace to recover from burnout, ease chronic pain, support their immune system, detox more deeply, and feel more energized and clear, both physically and emotionally. Whether they’re dealing with inflammation, fatigue, stress, or just want to feel more alive in their body again, the results speak for themselves.

settings.heading: Ben Azadi
settings.subheading: NYT Best Selling Author of Metabolic Freedom
settings.content:
"Most saunas just make you sweat—SaunaSpace helps you heal. It combines near-infrared light therapy with zero EMF, zero flicker technology to deliver deep cellular repair without the hidden stressors found in typical infrared units.

I love that it’s made with non-toxic materials like organic cotton and sustainable wood, and the fact that it’s portable means I can take my healing sanctuary anywhere. This isn’t just about sweating—it’s about mitochondrial repair, circadian rhythm optimization, and activating the body’s innate intelligence to detox, heal, and thrive."

settings.heading: Dr. Courtney Kahla
settings.content:
"I’ve been using SaunaSpace for years and I’m so happy with it! One of my favorite features is its incandescent bulb, which is perfect since you can’t look at LED lights.

The warmth it provides is incredibly soothing and makes each session so relaxing. Plus, it has zero EMF, giving me peace of mind about limiting my exposure to EMFs, unlike other brands.

I also use it over my thyroid for just 10 minutes every day, and I feel a surge of energy comparable to having a strong cup of coffee. SaunaSpace has truly been a game-changer for my wellness routine!"

settings.heading: Luke Storey
settings.subheading: Host of the Life Stylist Podcast, OG Biohacker
settings.content: "My SaunaSpace is a non-negotiable part of my weekly detox practice. It shields me from EMF, I get grounded from the grounding mat inside it, and I am getting the benefits of red light therapy deeply penetrating into the body while also sweating and detoxing."

settings.heading: Dr. Bryan Ardis
settings.content:
“People around the world walk up to me and ask me, ‘Dr Ardis, What can I do to stay healthy? what do YOU do every day stay healthy?’ Well, outside of diet, nutrition, and supplementation and exercise, one of the basic principles of staying healthy is detoxing.

One of the easiest and most efficient ways to actually detox and provide healing benefits is to use a sauna. There are many different saunas in the world. I have only one in my home: SaunaSpace. There’s very few technology devices on earth I’ve ever said I loved. I love SaunaSpace.”

settings.heading: Harrison Butker
settings.content: “With this season’s COVID restrictions, NFL players have been unable to use their team’s sauna. That reality, coupled with its unbeatably low EMF levels, make owning my very own FireLight Sauna and Glow a lifesaver. I got the SilverLining. I am grateful for this quality product made by SaunaSpace!”

settings.heading: Ragga Ragnars (Ragnheiður Ragnarsdóttir)
settings.content:
“Having my SaunaSpace FireLight in my bedroom has been an absolute game changer for me. I love being able to take time for myself, meditate, read, journal, or just sit in there with my thoughts.

Since I got it I have noticed an amazing improvement in how I feel, my recovery time from workouts has been cut in half and my skin is glowing. I also have a Glow and it's so nice and cozy to use that while I work on my computer or read. Also my 8 year old son loves it and will sit by it and do his homework.”

settings.heading: Dr. Terry Wahls
settings.content: "I am still very much enjoying my sauna most mornings! I definitely prefer the incandescent lamp heat over the far-infrared heaters in my old cabinet sauna."

settings.heading: Dr. Henry Ealy
settings.content:
"I've tested the SaunaSpace FireLight Incandescent Bulb and it doesn't meet my expectations... It EXCEEDS them! There is no doubt that SaunaSpace products are the premier products for both Red Light & NIR Therapy in the world today.

They've become a huge part of my health and healing routine and we are proud to teach their healing potential at Healing for the A.G.E.S. & the Energetic Health Institute! Thank you Brian!"

settings.heading: Dr. Jana Schmidt
settings.subheading: ND, CNHP, MH, PhD, EP, Min.
settings.content:
"The Firelight Infrared Sauna and Glow are truly two of the most beneficial purchases I’ve made. They are high quality in every respect and beautifully made. 

Incorporating red light therapy in my family’s daily routine has been effortless and enjoyable. It adds to strengthening our immune systems and detoxifying our bodies. As well as gently and effectively bringing tranquillity balance, clarity to our lives."

settings.heading: Chris Kresser
settings.subheading: MS, LAc, Author, Kresser Institute Founder
settings.content:
“I believe that near-infrared is the most therapeutic of the sauna options, and I love that the SilverLining not only doesn’t emit EMF or MF, it blocks out all ambient EMF for a completely ‘clean’ detox experience.

I’ve noticed benefits in sleep, mood, energy, and overall vitality after just a couple of weeks of using it. I even put my far infrared sauna on Craigslist because I haven’t used it once since I got the SaunaSpace.”

settings.heading: Dr. Melissa Sonners
settings.content:
"Our Glow Light has become a staple in our home. We have it on our coffee table and mornings and evenings in our home are so chillax now. It feels as if we have a warm glowing bonfire that we all gather around. 

It’s funny how kids just KNOW what’s good for them and they crave it just as much as I do. The Glow has helped create a beautiful morning and evening ritual in our home that creates connection with one another and a sense of peace and calm in us all at the beginning and end of our days.

It’s hands down one of my favorite purchases I have ever made for myself and our family."

settings.heading: Dr. Thomas Cowan
settings.subheading: MD, Author, Founder of Dr. Cowan's Garden
settings.content:
"The SaunaSpace incandescent red light lamps and saunas are a truly revolutionary technology. Akin to bring the healing wavelengths of the sun into your home, exposure to red light, incandescent light stimulates mitochondrial function and effective detoxification.

I use mine every day and believe the SaunaSpace products are one of the most profound therapeutic tools available."

settings.heading: Dr. Ken Sharlin
settings.content:
"As a doctor passionate about helping my patients identify and treat the root causes of chronic neurological conditions, the SaunaSpace has become an essential element in my toolbox.

In this demanding world of ‘eat this, not that,’ SaunaSpace invites us into its sacred, protected space, where—through the healing powers of red light and heat—all we are asked to do is just sit and breathe. We need more of that in our lives."

settings.name: Anthony Kunkel
settings.review: "I tore a quad muscle running a few years back, and my PT projected 8 weeks to recover. As a professional runner, that’s not acceptable for me. I was grateful to be able to hit the knee and quad multiple times a day with my Glow right at home, if just to warm it up before cross training sessions, but ultimately I was running again in just 4 weeks. I credit the majority of that miracle to my use of the Glow. With all the research I’ve seen behind near IR, it’s not surprising that it helps the root issues and helps avoid re-injury with added collagen and elastin to the area."

settings.name: JP “Young Savage” and Cheyenne “Warrior Princess” Buys
settings.review:
JP: "Even the days that I’m hurt, and my body’s hurt from training, I wake up, roll straight into the sauna, it wakes me up, and I can train. In my last fight, it was almost like we rehearsed it. In that quick second my brain reacted and my body just followed."

Cheyanne: "We use it religiously! In the last 2 months, my skin has cleared up…the sauna has been a major game-changer for us!"
